messages:
harper.ops: RCA is published: https://internal.redwood/rca/3165432100. Summary: fallback model routing failed to activate during a high-error rollout because the rollout gate skipped the fallback label. Impact window ~30m; some requests hit higher-latency paths and saw increased errors. Full timeline and action table in doc. Owners: please ack by EOD.

deploy-bot: Timeline: 02:14 rollout start -> 02:22 error increase -> 02:28 failed fallback activation -> 02:35 manual rollback and route repair -> 02:44 stable. Traces and gating logs attached.

kai.eng: I'll own Action 1: "enforce fallback label invariant in rollout gate". Plan: add a preflight check and unit test plus an integration test in staging. ETA: Fri 2024-08-09. Will post PR link here.

neha.sre: I'll take Action 2: "canary fallback activation test". Steps: add a canary job that simulates failures and verifies fallback routing, plus an alert if activation fails. Proposed checkpoint: Mon 2024-08-12 09:30 PT. Can folks confirm availability?

oliver.prod: I'll draft the short CSM blurb for affected accounts and share here for quick review tomorrow. Need any phrasing constraints? Keep it brief: what happened, who may have been affected, and what we changed.

ticket-bot: Support summary: 8 tickets during window; majority timeouts. Links to customer threads added to the RCA.

harper.ops: Office hours to walk through the RCA and action items: Wed 2024-08-07 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Please drop questions in-thread beforehand.

kai.eng: ✅ taking the rollout gate fix. Will add tests and post PR.

neha.sre: ✅ checkpoint confirmed Mon 8/12 09:30 PT.

oliver.prod: ✅ will post draft by tomorrow AM.

harper.ops: Two asks: 1) owners, react with :white_check_mark: when you accept; 2) paste PR links, test results, and alert config screenshots back into this thread so I can close actions after the one-week verification window. If anything urgent, escalate in #eng-oncall.
